autoCompleteValues.$comment: A list of values that are used for auto completion.

ownership.description: Optional per-assignment override of the attribute definition's 'ownership' (AB#5187). Omit to inherit from the definition. Use it when one shared attribute definition needs a different owner on this type or record - e.g. a shared 'ClientId' that is Secret on FinApiConfiguration but SeedOwned on ServiceAccountConfiguration.

id.description: Attribute identifier in Pascal Case, optionally with namespace and version (e.g., 'Name', 'Query.Filter-1')

valueCkRecordId.description: Record type reference in Pascal Case (e.g., '${this}/FieldFilter')

valueCkEnumId.description: Enum type reference in Pascal Case (e.g., '${this}/TokenType')

ownership.description: Declares who owns this attribute's value and whether the value is portable (AB#5187). SeedOwned (default): the seed author owns it - a blueprint re-apply overwrites the tenant value, and the value is exported. TenantOwned: the tenant owns it - a re-apply keeps the existing value, and the value is still exported (defaultValues may seed a fresh tenant). RuntimeState: a service/operator/pipeline owns it - preserved on re-apply and excluded from ExportRt. Secret: a credential - preserved on re-apply and excluded from ExportRt. Omit to fall back to the deprecated 'isRuntimeState' alias (true -> RuntimeState, false/absent -> SeedOwned). Declaring both is an authoring error (OCTO-CK003).

isRuntimeState.description: DEPRECATED alias for 'ownership' (AB#5187), kept so models authored before it keep working unchanged: true maps to RuntimeState, false or absent maps to SeedOwned. In a COMPILED model this field is also emitted as a mirror of 'ownership' meaning 'preserved on Upsert' (true for TenantOwned, RuntimeState and Secret), so an engine that does not know 'ownership' yet degrades to preserve-and-exclude instead of resetting credentials. Do not declare it together with 'ownership' (OCTO-CK003).
